Aria (Account Exec): Heads up — ACME demo failing. They get 403 on embeddings only. In 20m sync with their SRE.
ACME Eng: We call embeddings and generate with same Authorization header and same X-Redwood-Org header. Generate works, embeddings 403: {"error":"missing_scope:embeddings"}. We pasted curl below.
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-01" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-main" https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hello"}'

Jules (Presales): Likely a scopes problem on the key. Can you run /v1/keys/introspect with that token? It will show scopes and binding.
ACME Eng: Introspect returns: {"kid":"k123", "scopes": ["generate"], "binding": "org=acme-main"} — so it's generate-only. We thought onboarding key included embeddings.
Ravi (API): That's the default onboarding behavior for trial keys. We intentionally limit scopes to reduce blast radius. For demos we can issue a combined-scope temporary key.
Marta (Security): If you issue temp key, TTL should be <= 12h and scope-limited. Add note to security questionnaire that POC used temp key. Also ensure key is logged.
Aria (Account Exec): Customer asked if we can provide a single key for both endpoints for the demo — yes/no? They also want to know cost if embeddings volume goes up later.
Ravi (API): Provide combined-scope temp key for demo. For pricing: embeddings priced per vector unit; for a POC burst we can enable a short-term throughput bump. I'll get ops estimate.
KeyManagerBot: Issued temporary key sk-poc-2390012345, kid=pk9, scopes=[generate,embeddings], binding=org=acme-main, expires=2025-03-05T02:00:00Z
ACME Eng: Retested — embeddings 200 OK. Thanks! Two additional notes: 1) our client retries sometimes drop custom headers on preflight; that caused a 401 earlier, fixed on our side. 2) We observed a 403 at 02:00 UTC once due to TTL mismatch (client timezone).
Jules (Presales): Good catch on client header stripping and timezone. We should add a short troubleshooting tip for demos: ensure your proxy preserves Authorization and X-Redwood-Org; use introspect to confirm binding; confirm system clock/UTC for token expiry.
Marta (Security): I'll draft the security questionnaire answers and include how we handle temp keys, rotation, and logging.
Aria (Account Exec): Follow-ups: 1) confirm ops pricing for embeddings burst (Ravi) 2) Marta to send security pack 3) Update CRM that temp combined key issued (Aria) 4) ACME to validate client header behavior before demo.
ACME Eng: We'll validate and confirm. Appreciate the quick support :thumbsup:
